title: VTC Badges — Retire — payload
description: Retire a badge: it is given to nobody again, its open offers are withdrawn, and for a community badge its status-bearing credentials are revoked and its badge group deleted; every award is kept for its holders' own history. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

reason.description: Why, recorded with the change and shown to anyone who must approve it.

Response.title: VTC Badges — Retire — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/badges/retire/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/badges/retire/0.1#response.

badge.description: The badge, `state` `retired`, with `retiredAt`. `groupId` stays on a community badge as the identifier of the group that was deleted, for the awards' history.
